mainEntity.name: What is your process for handling unexpected issues during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unexpected issues, such as discovering mold, unforeseen plumbing problems, or structural concerns, can sometimes arise during demolition in older homes common in the East Bay. Our process for handling these involves immediately stopping work in the affected area, thoroughly assessing the issue, and providing you with a clear explanation of the problem, potential solutions, and any impact on the project timeline or budget. We believe in transparent communication and will always seek your approval before proceeding with any additional work required.
acceptedAnswer.description: We address unexpected remodel issues by stopping work, assessing the problem, providing clear explanations, and discussing solutions and impacts on timeline/budget, seeking your approval before proceeding.
